format: C++ header file (likely for Qt framework)
description: This header defines the interface for a simple calculator application involving a core calculation engine (`CalculatorEngine`) and a UI widget (`CalculatorWidget`). The file includes class declarations, method signatures, and comments describing the functionality, styling, and interactions of the calculator components.

classes.name: CalculatorEngine
classes.description: Provides core arithmetic parsing, evaluation, and state management for calculator operations, including handling input digits, operators, decimal points, and special functions like clear and backspace. Supports left-to-right evaluation without operator precedence, and handles division-by-zero errors.

classes.name: CalculatorWidget
classes.description: Implements the graphical user interface for the calculator using Qt widgets, including display labels, input line edit, and buttons, with styling based on the Ocean Professional theme. Responsible for user interactions and delegate calculation logic to CalculatorEngine.

methods.name: CalculatorEngine()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the calculator engine state.

methods.name: void clearAll()
methods.description: Resets the calculator's internal state and input.

methods.name: void backspace()
methods.description: Deletes the last character from current input.

methods.name: void inputDigit(int d)
methods.description: Appends a digit (0-9) to the current input.

methods.name: void inputDecimal()
methods.description: Adds a decimal point to current input if not already present.

methods.name: void inputOperator(QChar op)
methods.description: Queues an operator (+, -, *, /) and processes pending operations.

methods.name: QString evaluateEquals()
methods.description: Performs evaluation of the current expression and returns the result as a string, handling division by zero.

methods.name: QString currentInput() const
methods.description: Retrieves the current input string being constructed.

methods.name: QString currentResult() const
methods.description: Retrieves the current accumulated calculation result.

methods.name: static QString computeExpressionLTR(const QString &expr, bool *ok = nullptr)
methods.description: Performs left-to-right evaluation of a simple expression string, returning 'Error' on invalid input or division by zero.

methods.name: bool foldPending()
methods.description: Auxiliary method that applies pending operator to the accumulator and current input, used internally.

methods.name: static bool isOperator(QChar c)
methods.description: Checks if a character is a valid operator.

methods.name: CalculatorWidget(QWidget *parent = nullptr)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the calculator UI components and layout.

methods.name: void onDigitClicked()
methods.description: Slot triggered when a digit button is pressed.

methods.name: void onDecimalClicked()
methods.description: Slot triggered when the decimal point button is pressed.

methods.name: void onOperatorClicked()
methods.description: Slot triggered when an operator button is pressed.

methods.name: void onClearClicked()
methods.description: Slot for clearing the calculator state.

methods.name: void onBackspaceClicked()
methods.description: Slot for deleting last character of input.

methods.name: void onEqualsClicked()
methods.description: Slot for performing calculation evaluation.

methods.name: void buildUI()
methods.description: Sets up the UI layout and widgets.

methods.name: void applyTheme()
methods.description: Applies Ocean Professional style to UI components.

methods.name: void connectSignals()
methods.description: Connects UI signals to appropriate slots.

methods.name: void refreshDisplay(const QString &secondaryHint = QString())
methods.description: Updates calculator display labels.

methods.name: QPushButton* makeButton(const QString &text, const QString &role)
methods.description: Helper for creating styled buttons.
